<ApiTitle method="patch" title="Update Deliverable" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/v1/deliverable/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}

Changes a deliverable's name, description, folder, tags or fonts; only the fields you send change. Sending `tags` replaces the whole tag list, and an empty array removes every tag.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
